headlines.headline: Record $12.5B Lakers sale awaits Board of Governors vote
headlines.detail: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger's agreement to buy the Lakers from Mark Walter is the largest sports-franchise sale on record, up 20-25% from the $10B Walter paid in June 2025.

headlines.headline: Seahawks hand Chiefs first loss of the season, 20-3
headlines.detail: Seattle improved to 4-3 behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba (9 catches, 150 yds, TD) and Emanuel Wilson (100 rush yds), dropping Kansas City to 5-1.

headlines.headline: BYU's comeback win over Notre Dame reshapes the playoff picture
headlines.detail: No. 8 BYU beat No. 2 Notre Dame 28-24 on Oct. 17 on a late Bear Bachmeier TD pass and goal-line stop, pushing the then-unbeaten Cougars into the four-team playoff conversation.

headlines.headline: Florida opens season No. 1 in AP poll for first time since 2006
headlines.detail: Florida took 47 of 59 first-place votes ahead of Duke, Illinois, UConn and Arizona. Defending champ Michigan fell to No. 16 after coach Dusty May departed. Season tips off Nov. 2.
